comparator.name: Bachelor Electrical Engineering
comparator.academicYear: 2026–2027 adopted OER; ordinary current entrant requirements
comparator.sourceNotes: Freshly retrieved 2026–2027 EEMCS OER, articles 6–7 (PDF pp.25–29), controls the ordinary current requirements. Year one has twelve required 5-EC courses. Year two has nine required 5-EC courses, Electrical Engineering for the Next Generation 10 EC and one restricted elective 5 EC. Year three has a genuine approved minor 30 EC, Signal Processing 5 EC, Computer Architecture and Organisation 5 EC, a second restricted elective 5 EC and the graduation project 15 EC. Year totals are 60+60+60=180. Select the first two distinct listed options, EEX01 Introduction to Machine Learning in year two and EEX02 Communication Networks and Algorithms in year three, independently of UCR fit; EEX03–05 are unselected alternatives, not extra credits. Minor content must not overlap the selected electives. The formal table places Mixed-Signal Circuits and Systems EE2C2 in Q3 while the still-linked 2025–2026 chart puts it in Q4; exact quarter scheduling is not asserted or derived from an assumed 15-EC quarterly allocation. Current formal entry requirements replace older chart statements: Project 1 requires the Linear Circuits A course lab and Introduction mentorship; Project 2 requires Project 1 and both Digital Systems labs; Project 3 requires positive BSA, Project 1, Signals and Systems lab and either Linear Circuits B or Calculus. Electives require positive BSA; Next Generation requires all three projects and Electrical Energy Fundamentals or Linear Algebra and Differential Equations, with at least 5 in the other. Graduation requires every first- and second-year course. Dutch admission proficiency remains distinct from the predominantly English course instruction and mixed English/Dutch first-year projects. The module-level weights and yearly allocation are verified; no precise external timetable is certified. Current tables and choice/prerequisite clauses visually inspected on 8 October 2026.
